description:
Affected extension: custom-footer.ex
Upstream: the footer factory receives a footerData argument with:
  - footerData.getGitBranch(): returns the current git branch name.
  - footerData.onBranchChange(cb): subscribes to git branch change events; returns an unsubscribe fn.
  - footerData.getExtensionStatuses(): returns texts from ctx.ui.setStatus() calls.
These are only exposed inside the footer factory — not available via ctx directly — because they are UI-lifecycle-scoped data that require the footer to register/unregister subscriptions on mount/unmount.
Current workaround: branch name and token stats are omitted from the custom footer.
What's needed: when the TUI calls a footer render factory (see opi-rcg.8), pass a footerData struct. footerData.getGitBranch() can call git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD. onBranchChange needs a pubsub mechanism (e.g. a git poller or terminal title-change hook).
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/custom-footer.ts (footerData parameter)
title: footerData — git branch accessor and onBranchChange subscription for footer components
